evals.prompt: Which Nginx book should I read as a beginner vs as a sysadmin tuning performance?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the Books topic in nginx-admins-handbook, recommends Nginx Essentials for beginners and Nginx High Performance / Mastering Nginx for sysadmins.
expectations: Reads references/index.md and references/sources.json
Recommends book(s) appropriate to the user's level
Cites each pick with exact title + URL + [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Recommend a config generator so I can scaffold an nginx.conf with sane TLS defaults.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Config generators topic and recommends nginxconfig.io (and/or Mozilla SSL config generator) with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Config generators topic
Recommends nginxconfig.io and/or Mozilla SSL config generator
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: How do I parse a running nginx.conf programmatically into JSON for tooling?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Config parsers topic and recommends crossplane (and/or nginxparser) with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Config parsers topic
Recommends crossplane
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Lint my nginx.conf for misconfigurations and security pitfalls.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Static analyzers topic and recommends gixy (and nginx-config-formatter / nginxbeautifier) with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Static analyzers topic
Recommends gixy
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: I want to analyze Nginx access logs in real time on the CLI. What's the best tool?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Log analyzers + Performance analyzers and recommends GoAccess / ngxtop with provenance.
expectations: Routes to Log analyzers and Performance analyzers
Recommends GoAccess and/or ngxtop
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Load-test my Nginx reverse proxy — what's the right benchmarking tool?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Benchmarking tools, distinguishes throughput (wrk) vs load (vegeta) vs DoS-simulator (slowloris), and recommends accordingly.
expectations: Routes to the Benchmarking tools topic
Distinguishes throughput vs load vs DoS-simulator categories
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: How do I harden Nginx TLS — HSTS, OCSP stapling, modern ciphers, PFS?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Performance & Hardening topic and recommends the SSL Labs / Mozilla Observatory / testssl.sh tools plus hardening patterns.
expectations: Routes to the Performance & Hardening topic
Mentions HSTS / OCSP stapling / PFS / TLS 1.2-1.3 ciphers
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Test my Nginx SSL/TLS config externally — which scanner should I use?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Security & Web testing tools and recommends testssl.sh / ssllabs-scan / sslyze / h2spec with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Security & Web testing tools topic
Recommends testssl.sh / ssllabs-scan / sslyze
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Debug a stuck Nginx worker process at runtime — what low-level tools should I reach for?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Debugging tools and recommends strace / gdb / SystemTap / htrace.sh with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Debugging tools topic
Recommends strace / gdb / SystemTap / htrace.sh
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]

evals.prompt: Manage Nginx across a fleet with Ansible — is there a good role?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Config managers topic and recommends jdauphant / geerlingguy / nginxinc / voxpupuli Ansible/Puppet roles with provenance.
expectations: Routes to the Config managers topic
Recommends an Ansible role (e.g. geerlingguy or jdauphant)
Cites with [src:nginx-admins-handbook]
